title: Map Enhancer - Map Editing Inside RPG Maker [MV, MZ ]

posts.author: Pheonix KageDesu
posts.body:
Map Enhancer
Pheonix KageDesu
​
Features
​
Enhance Your Game Maps with extra visual objects (images), collision zones and group condidtions
Launch the editor right in the game (only in test mode)
Different modes (placing objects, adding collisions, setting conditions)
A window with hints for each mode. Supports three languages: English, Russian, Chinese
Group objects (and collisions) into groups and set visibility conditions for them in the game, creating dynamic changes to the game map
Placing the object off-grid with shift control, with accuracy up to 1 pixel.
Plugin works with RPG Maker MZ and MV.
​
How to Use:
Plugin have Demo project with examples and Guide.
Plugin webpage
Download:
Download from MEGA (select Map Enhancer folder)
Terms of Use:
Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution, Share Alike, Non-Commercial
(Attribution Non-Commercial Share Alike, cc by-nc-sa)
You can use plugin in non-commercial projects for free
For using plugin in commercial projects you should obtain PRO version of plugin
